description: This file defines the PaymentType entity class, which models different payment types within the Fineract system. It includes mapping annotations for database persistence, fields representing properties of payment types, and an update method for modifying these properties based on JSON commands.

classes.name: PaymentType
classes.description: Represents a payment type entity with properties such as name, description, whether it's cash payment, order position, code name, and system-defined flag. Provides mechanisms to update properties based on external JSON commands.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the properties of the PaymentType instance based on the provided JsonCommand, tracking and returning any changes made.
